clusters.title: Fix Installation Failures and Security Issues
clusters.summary: Users are encountering multiple dependency installation failures including undefined variables, package import errors, and CLIP installation issues that block initial setup. Additionally, security vulnerabilities in the installation pipeline create risks of credential harvesting, supply chain attacks, and shell injection. Users also want configuration flexibility to override forced torch versions for GPU compatibility.
clusters.representative_need: Add MIDI file generation with multi-instrument support
sample_titles: Add MIDI file generation with multi-instrument support
Allow users to override the forced torch version for GPU compatibility
Fix CLIP package installation failure on fresh installations
